The Children and Families Department takes a strengths-based approach to working with each other, children, young people and families, and our partner agencies. We call this 'Our Nottinghamshire Approach'. Watch the two minute animation to learn more.

Nottinghamshire County Council
is dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive environment for children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND). We are committed to ensuring that every child has access to high-quality education and care, empowering them to thrive in their communities.

Are you passionate about making a difference in the lives of children and young people with SEND? As the Place Planning Officer (SEND)
, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that Nottinghamshire has sufficient high-quality SEND education and childcare places for children and young people aged 0-25. You will support the development and delivery of our SEND Place Planning Strategy through insightful analysis of demographic trends and pupil projections.

In This Exciting Role, Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

Forecasting Future Demand: Anticipate the need for SEND places based on demographic data and trends.
Data Management: Manage and analyse complex data to inform strategic decisions.
Collaboration: Work closely with schools, local authorities, planners, and housing developers to ensure SEND needs are integrated into infrastructure planning.
Expert Advice: Provide guidance to senior leaders and elected members on SEND matters.
Funding Support: Assist in securing funding for additional SEND provisions.
New School Establishment: Support the establishment of new SEND schools to meet local needs.

To Succeed In This Role, You Will Need

A degree or equivalent qualification in SEND, Education, Social Care, or a related field.
In-depth knowledge of SEND legislation and statutory processes.
Experience in managing complex data and contributing to strategic planning.
A strong understanding of safeguarding frameworks and quality assurance methodologies.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Demonstrate

Leadership: Ability to influence and inspire others in a collaborative environment.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills to engage diverse audiences.
Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills, particularly in data-driven decision-making.
Resilience: A commitment to service excellence and personal accountability.

At Nottinghamshire County Council, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued. Our benefits include:

A Place to Belong: Join a friendly, inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.
Professional Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible working arrangements to support your lifestyle.
Generous Leave: Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with ample leave options.

Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity to make a real difference in your community! If you are ready to take on this rewarding challenge and help shape the future for children and young people with SEND, apply today!

For an informal discussion about this opportunity please contact Sinead Allan
on 01158043906
or by email sinead.allan@nottscc.gov.uk.

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Start here. Grow here.

Due to significant infrastructure planning wins and new opportunities, we are looking to hire a Senior Town Planner.
You will be joining a great team; you will have an interesting and diverse workload and you will be given the opportunity to make the most of your abilities.

As our Town Planning team is national, and we support hybrid working we are flexible in terms of base location. The role can be based from our offices in Basingstoke, Birmingham, Bristol, Chesterfield, Leeds, London Aldgate, and Plymouth,
whilst taking advantage of our hybrid working model.

You will be able to work on a range of prestigious infrastructure projects for our clients in the energy transition, rail and water development sectors, as well as a range of regional and local developments. AECOM is a market leader in UK infrastructure development, with experience of over 80 DCO projects. Join us now and you could be working on:
numerous solar DCOs with a pipeline of future work;
carbon capture and storage projects;
energy transmission schemes;
large aviation and rail projects; and
housing and mixed-use development consenting.

You will be joining a market leading, experienced infrastructure planning team and will, be given the following responsibilities.

Here’s what you’ll do:

Project Coordination and Delivery

Assisting in the successful delivery of major development applications and coordinating multi-disciplinary teams across various project types.
Assisting with project management and implementing quality and health and safety principles.

Planning Advice and Strategy

Providing planning advice to colleagues and clients on planning consent requirements and the application of permitted development rights.
Carrying out planning research and analysis and assisting with planning feasibility reports and consent strategies.

Documentation and Application Management

Writing Planning Statements and Design and Access Statements for development applications.
Leading, submitting, and managing planning applications, including liaison and negotiation with local planning authorities and other key stakeholders.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement

Working closely with the Environmental Impact Assessment team.
Participating in internal and external meetings.

Research, Business Development, and Project Management

Contribution to the preparation of successful commercial tenders.
Carrying out planning research and analysis and assisting with planning feasibility reports and consent strategies.

AECOM’s rapidly growing Town Planning team plays a key role in delivering major infrastructure and development projects.

AECOM is a top ten UK planning consultancy by size, employing more than 70 Chartered or Licentiate Planners. AECOM is also a worldwide leader in environmental and engineering consultancy and working as a planning consultant within AECOM means access to some of the highest profile and prestigious development projects in the UK, working with colleagues operating at the cutting edge of their disciplines as part of the largest UK environmental consultancy.

Become part of our Environment business, and collaborate with top-tier planners, impact assessment specialists and project managers to consent a variety of captivating projects, from local developments to major and national infrastructure, from developing planning strategies to obtaining consent and post consent work. At AECOM, you’ll thrive in an inclusive and forward-thinking environment where your contributions are valued.

Come grow with us.

Qualifications

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Education and Qualifications

Degree in Town Planning or a related discipline (desirable).
Membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) or an equivalent professional body (desirable).

Experience

Demonstrable and relevant experience of working on planning applications.

Knowledge

Sound knowledge of English planning policy and legislation.

Skills

Commercial awareness.
Ability to write clearly and concisely.

Personal Qualities

Client focus, with good interpersonal skills and a collaborative working approach.
High level of commitment to quality.

Additional Information

Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

For further information about the role, reach out to the recruiter on LinkedIn Anne-Marie Flynn

To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. Extracts, analyzes, and coordinates data to assist business segments with making changes to policies, procedures, and business practices

Ensures compliance with deliverable reporting requirements by performing quality data audits and analysis

Excellent organization and time management skills

As the workforce architecture model matures, the analyst will provide analytical support to HR Business Partners leading workforce architecture projects within their client groups while ensuring a consistent methodology, data foundation, and decision-making framework across the enterprise.

Conduct workforce impact assessments to evaluate the effect of business, technology, process, and organizational changes on jobs, skills, and talent supply & demand

Analyze labor demand, workforce demographics, attrition patterns, internal mobility trends, and skills data to inform strategic workforce decisions.

3 years of experience in People Analytics or Finance
Familiarity with workforce planning, transformation, internal mobility and action planning concepts

Experience creating executive level presentations

At Regions, the Human Resources Data and Reporting Analyst maintains data sources and platforms and provides structure and guidelines for ensuring quality data and reporting. This role may also participate in data analysis and research projects to solve problems and provide actionable insights for organizational decision-making.

Primary Responsibilities

Creates and maintains databases and management reports; analyzes and interprets data to identify anomalies, trends and opportunities for improvements
Maintains, develops and builds data sources using the Workday Prism platform
Extracts, analyzes, and coordinates data to assist business segments with making changes to policies, procedures, and business practices

Prepares reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information
Captures, develops, and documents Human Resources data definitions, business rules, and data quality requirements
Ensures compliance with deliverable reporting requirements by performing quality data audits and analysis
Works with managers to apply data to business goals and analytical requirements, which may include capacity planning, volume forecasting and unit costing
Operates under moderate supervision
Works within established procedures with a moderate degree of supervision

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Requirements

Bachelors degree in Business, Data Management, Statistics, Math, Economics, or related field
Three (3) years of relevant experience
Demonstrated experience with Workday Reporting

Experience with the Workday Prism platform

Excellent organization and time management skills
Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Power Point) and Access

As the workforce architecture model matures, the analyst will provide analytical support to HR Business Partners leading workforce architecture projects within their client groups while ensuring a consistent methodology, data foundation, and decision-making framework across the enterprise.

Duties

Conduct workforce impact assessments to evaluate the effect of business, technology, process, and organizational changes on jobs, skills, and talent supply & demand
Develop scenario analyses to identify future workforce gaps and the viability of potential action plans
Analyze labor demand, workforce demographics, attrition patterns, internal mobility trends, and skills data to inform strategic workforce decisions.
Translate complex workforce data into narratives connected to business outcomes, productivity, risk mitigation, and organizational readiness

Additional Preferences

3 years of experience in People Analytics or Finance
Familiarity with workforce planning, transformation, internal mobility and action planning concepts
Experience using Power BI, Tableau, or other analytical tools
Experience creating executive level presentations

new_jobs.description:
About The Role

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager owns the strategic relationship and customer experience across a portfolio of ComplyAdvantage’s enterprise customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary strategic partner, helping them adopt our technology, realize measurable value and strengthen their financial-crime risk programs.

You will act as the quarterback of the customer relationship, coordinating the right resources across Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product and leadership. Success requires strong executive presence, commercial judgment and the ability to navigate complex customer organizations.

This role goes beyond relationship management. You will be accountable for customer health, adoption, value realization, retention and the identification of credible growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

Lead strategic customer relationships

Own a portfolio of complex enterprise and financial-services customers.
Build trusted relationships across the customer organization, from operational users to executive sponsors and economic buyers.
Develop a clear understanding of each customer’s business model, financial-crime program, priorities and measures of success.
Establish multithreaded relationships so customer success does not depend on a single champion.
Lead Customer Value Reviews and executive business reviews focused on outcomes, value and future priorities.
Maintain an appropriate engagement cadence based on customer value, complexity and risk.

Drive Adoption and Measurable Value

Create and maintain success plans that connect product capabilities to the customer’s business and risk-management objectives.
Establish measurable success criteria during onboarding and carry those outcomes through implementation, adoption and renewal.
Monitor product usage, customer engagement, support trends and qualitative relationship signals.
Identify adoption barriers early and coordinate the resources required to resolve them.
Help customers optimize their use of the platform and demonstrate realized value to their stakeholders.

Own Customer Health and Risk

Maintain an accurate, evidence-based assessment of customer health.
Identify risks before they become escalations or renewal concerns.
Develop clear action plans with defined owners, milestones and expected outcomes.
Lead internal customer health discussions and ensure follow-through across functions.
Manage complex escalations calmly, balancing customer advocacy with the company’s business priorities.
Provide leadership with a clear view of portfolio risks and recommended actions.

Support Retention and Growth

Maintain a disciplined view of renewal probability, customer sentiment and commercial risk.
Partner with Sales on renewal and expansion strategy while maintaining clear accountability for the customer relationship.
Identify growth opportunities based on customer needs, new use cases and measurable value.
Engage economic buyers well before renewal and ensure they understand the value of the partnership.
Contribute to GRR, NRR, forecast accuracy and qualified expansion targets.
Participate confidently in commercial conversations and negotiations.

Lead Cross-Functionally

Coordinate Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product and executive stakeholders around a consistent customer plan.
Ensure clean transitions from pre-sales through implementation and into ongoing success.
Bring the right specialists into the customer relationship without surrendering ownership.
Represent customer priorities internally with context, evidence and a clear recommendation.
Set realistic expectations with customers and hold internal partners accountable for commitments.
Share customer insights that can improve the product, operating model and overall customer experience.

What Success Looks Like

Within this role, you will:

Build strong relationships with executive sponsors and economic buyers.
Improve adoption and measurable value across your customer portfolio.
Maintain accurate customer health assessments and renewal forecasts.
Reduce late-stage escalations and unexpected renewal risk.
Deliver consistent, outcome-focused Customer Value Reviews and EBRs.
Achieve portfolio retention and growth targets.
Identify qualified expansion opportunities based on demonstrated customer need.
Create a coordinated experience across every stage of the customer journey.

What You’ll Bring

A track record of managing a complex portfolio with meaningful ARR responsibility.
Demonstrated success improving customer adoption, retention and expansion.
Experience leading executive-level customer relationships and business reviews.
Strong commercial judgment, including experience with renewals, forecasting, expansion and contract discussions.
Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes and measurable value.
Experience navigating complex implementations, escalations and cross-functional dependencies.
Strong operational discipline across success planning, account planning, health management and forecasting.
Executive-level communication, presentation and storytelling skills.
The ability to bring structure to ambiguity, influence without authority and remain composed under pressure.
A proactive ownership mindset with a willingness to challenge assumptions and recommend action.

Basic Qualifications

Minimum of six (6) years experience in customer success, strategic account management or enterprise consulting within a SaaS environment.
Minimum of four (4) years experience working with enterprise customers (Fortune 500)
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without need for current or future sponsorship

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting financial institutions, fintech companies or other regulated enterprises.
Knowledge of financial-crime risk management, AML, transaction monitoring, customer screening or payment screening.
Experience working with data, integrations, APIs and technically complex SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with customer-success platforms such as Gainsight.
Experience using customer-health models, product-usage data and AI-enabled tools to improve customer engagement and CSM productivity.

How We Measure Success

Performance will be evaluated through a balanced set of customer and business outcomes, including:

Gross Revenue Retention
Net Revenue Retention
Renewal and risk forecast accuracy
Product adoption and utilization
Customer health and risk movement
Executive sponsor coverage
Customer Value Review and EBR quality
Customer satisfaction and advocacy
Qualified expansion opportunities
Demonstrated customer outcomes

The strongest candidates combine customer empathy with commercial accountability. They build trusted relationships while maintaining the discipline, judgment and executive presence required to protect and grow the business.

How We Work

Our values describe how we operate, and they map closely to this role:

Make a safer world: Every role here contributes to financial systems that are harder for criminals to exploit. You will keep the customer and the real-world outcome of our work visible in everything the team does.
Raise the bar: We set ambitious standards and pursue them with discipline, never settling for good enough. You will raise the bar on the team's capability and craft, and balance that ambition with care for the people behind it.
See it, own it, drive it forward: We notice what needs to change, take personal responsibility, and move with purpose. You will lead with a bias for action and see things through.
Win as one team: Financial crime is complex and global, and no function solves it alone. You will build trust and shared goals across Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering.

What’s in it for you?

Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building
Unlimited Time Off Policy- A work-life balance and focus on our well-being are critical to keeping us performing at our best
Annual learning budget to drive your performance and career development
Budget to set up your home office upon joining
Parental leave and childcare benefits
Life Insurance to protect your loved ones
Medical (100%), Dental (90%), and Vision (80%) contribution
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) to allow you to use tax free dollars for healthcare or day care related expenses
401k Contribution
Financial Perks (Financial Advice, PerkSpot discounts, Pet Insurance discounts, Travel assistance)
Pre-Tax transit benefits

The base salary range for this role is $130,00 to $170,000 + commission, equity, and US benefits. The actual pay may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and skills.

About us:

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime.

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca.
